title: The Christmas Letter (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy absurdist Christmas family
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The Christmas letter arrives in the mail from somebody every year
A summary of their twelve months and the wins and atmosphere
Of a family doing things in places you've been told about
The Christmas letter is a newsletter that nobody opted out

[Pre-Chorus]
Ours is two paragraphs and it says the family's well
Which it is — and we've left the rest for people to tell

[Chorus]
The Christmas letter knows something I don't know
It knows the edited version of the year's particular flow
The Christmas letter curates the acceptable and the bright
And files the difficult in the drawer until after December night
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
Some letters run to four pages and include a photo spread
Of people I once met standing in places where they've been and said
Were wonderful — and they were — and the letter confirms this
The Christmas letter is the year's best attempt at bliss

[Bridge]
I sent one once in 1987 that I wrote in full sincerity
About nothing in particular but the family's general clarity
About its situation — and we never got one back
Which I've taken as a compliment ever since — that's the track

[Outro]
Christmas letter knows… the curated version of the year… Christmas letter knows
That's my boy
